page_title: ROM 3-0 UDI | AS Roma v Udinese 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Ermano Feliciani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Referee Ermano Feliciani sees the trip by Sandi Lovric (Udinese) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

90+1' Angelino (AS Roma) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
90+1' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Matias Soule (AS Roma) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
89' Ermano Feliciani blows the whistle, Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul.
88' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' The ball possession is 62:38.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is replacing Stephan El Shaarawy.
83' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manu Kone (AS Roma) replacing Bryan Cristante.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Matias Soule (AS Roma) coming on for Paulo Dybala.
82' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
80' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' A cross into the box from Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is cleared.
78' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Thauvin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
75' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Christian Kabasele and he is replaced by Isaak Toure (Udinese).
75' A pass from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
72' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
70' 3 - 0 Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
69' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini will be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
67' The foul by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was seen by Ermano Feliciani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
64' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
64' A substitution has been made. Hassane Kamara goes off and Jordan Zemura (Udinese) comes on.
63' Here is a change. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
62' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Substitution. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) has come on for Niccolo Pisilli.
60' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
59' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
59' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
57' Brenner (Udinese) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
54' Keinan Davis (Udinese) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Florian Thauvin, but the ball goes just over the bar.
54' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
53' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Ermano Feliciani signals a foul.
52' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
49' 2 - 0 Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) smoothly converts the penalty with a stunning effort which ends up inside the right post.
49' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
48' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. PENALTY to AS Roma! Great chance to score.
47' Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Christian Kabasele (Udinese).
47' Brenner (Udinese) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' Kosta Runjaic makes a switch. Keinan Davis (Udinese) is coming on in place of Lorenzo Lucca at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
44' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
42' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Handball by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
37' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma).
35' Angelino (AS Roma) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
34' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes.
32' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

28' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will take a throw-in.
26' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
22' 68:32 – the latest ball possession ratio.
19' 1 - 0 Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
16' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
16' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
14' Brenner (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
13' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
11' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
8' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Maduka Okoye.
7' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
4' The free kick is delivered by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
3' Yellow card. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani will supervise the game today.
